_comment: Player-facing change notes for every listed patch of the Runes Reforged page (runes-reforged.html), shown by the patch-notes control next to the Patch dropdown. Hand-curated from data/patches/reforged.json (changes, notes, sources) and the research behind it: every bullet is backed by that data, nothing is added.

patches: { <patch as in the listing>: { summary, items, kind } }. summary: one line, at most 90 characters, ending in " (approx.)" when the listing's confidence is low. items: short bullets, old → new values, at most about 8. kind: launch | rework | change | season-start | season-end | no-change; a season boundary without a rune change is no-change, and its count in the registry is 0.
tools/build-notes.js checks this file against the listing and writes data/notes/reforged-<season>.js (one LolData.register("notes", ...) per season).

V7.22.summary: Runes Reforged launch: 5 paths, 15 keystones, 60 runes
items: Runes Reforged replaces masteries and the old rune pages
5 paths: Precision, Domination, Sorcery, Resolve and Inspiration, each with 3 keystones and 3 rows of 3 runes
Primary path: 1 keystone and 3 runes; secondary path: 2 runes from different rows
Every primary and secondary path pairing grants a path bonus (Sorcery: +15 AD or +25 AP)

V7.23.summary: Predator and Summon Aery retuned; Ghost Poro channel rule; tooltip edits
items: Predator: damage 60–140 → 60–180; cooldown 180–120s → 150–100s
Summon Aery: damage 20–60 → 15–40
Ghost Poro: the channel is now interrupted by taking damage (was: entering combat with a champion)
Tooltip wording: Relentless Hunter, Arcane Comet, Celerity, Biscuit Delivery, Kleptomancy
Tooltip fix: Summon Aery and Cheap Shot say they hit enemy champions, and Revitalize that it strengthens the heals and shields you cast; all three always worked that way

V7.24.summary: Fleet Footwork, Lethal Tempo, Phase Rush and 10 more runes; path bonuses down
items: Fleet Footwork: heal 5–50 (+0.1 bonus AD, +0.2 AP) → 3–60 (+0.3 bonus AD, +0.4 AP), now boosted by critical hits
Lethal Tempo: cooldown 10s → 6s
Phase Rush: 75% Slow Resistance now for every champion (was melee only)
Presence of Mind: 5s → 7s
Coup de Grace: 10% → 9% damage; Triumph: 15% → 12% missing health; Celerity: 4% → 3% Movement Speed
Mirror Shell: +5 → +6 Magic Resist; Overheal: 30% → 40% of excess self-healing
Eyeball Collection: 2 eyeballs per champion kill and 1 per assist (was 2 per takedown); Revitalize now also counts heals and shields you receive

In the V7.24b follow-up patch: Scorch damage 30–60 → 20–60; Manaflow Band every 60s → 75s; path bonus Sorcery +15 → +12 AD or +25 → +20 AP, Inspiration with Domination or Sorcery +16 → +13 AD or +27 → +22 AP

V8.1.summary: Celerity tooltip gives its AD rate; Predator changes; Resolve path pairings split
items: Tooltip fix: Celerity converts bonus Movement Speed at 4.8% AD or 8% AP, as it has since launch (the old tooltip said 8% to AD or AP)
Predator: an interrupted channel now puts it on 50% cooldown; the first 1.5s of the boost give 67.5% Movement Speed (the tooltip still says 45% throughout, up to the V10.12 rework)
Path bonus for Resolve paired with Precision, Domination or Sorcery: half of each path's bonus, e.g. +18% Attack Speed or +130 Health → +9% Attack Speed and +65 Health

V8.2.summary: Aftershock and Guardian retuned; Glacial Augment, Grasp and Coup de Grace changes
items: Aftershock: resists 20 + 30% → 70–120; damage 40–140 (+3.5% max health) → 10–120 (+3% max health, +15% bonus AD, +10% AP)
Guardian: cooldown 45s → 70–40s; shield 60–150 → 70–150; AP ratio 20% → 25% (the tooltip prints 0.25%), bonus health 10% → 12%
Glacial Augment: ranged slow 20–40% → 30–40%, melee 40–50% → 45–55%; frozen ground slow 50% → 60%
Grasp of the Undying (ranged): damage, healing and permanent health now 40% lower (was: halved, +2 health)
Coup de Grace: 9% → 7%; Last Stand: 5–12% → 5–11%; Triumph: gold 25 → 20
Zombie Ward: duration 180s → 60–180s

V8.3.summary: Inspiration rows reshuffled; Unsealed Spellbook cooldowns 25% → 15%
items: Magical Footwear moves to the first Inspiration row, Biscuit Delivery to the second
Magical Footwear: the boots no longer upgrade for 50 gold less
Unsealed Spellbook: Summoner Spell cooldown reduction 25% → 15%

V8.4.summary: New runes Time Warp Tonic and Bone Plating; Resolve rows reshuffled
items: New rune: Time Warp Tonic (Inspiration, third row), replacing Celestial Body
New rune: Bone Plating (Resolve, first row)
Resolve: Unflinching moves to the third row, Second Wind to the second row (now 4 runes)
Press the Attack: damage 30–120 → 40–180; damage taken increase 12% → 4–12%
Perfect Timing: Stopwatch after 6 → 10 min
Path bonus for Precision paired with Domination or Sorcery: part Attack Speed, part AD/AP (e.g. +18% Attack Speed → +9% Attack Speed and +5 AD or +9 AP)
Inspiration path bonus: +20% potion and elixir duration removed

V8.5.summary: Press the Attack and Aftershock nerfs; Fleet Footwork minion heal (ranged)
items: Press the Attack: damage taken increase 4–12% → 8–12%
Aftershock: cooldown 20s → 35s
Fleet Footwork: healing from minions 30% effective for ranged champions
Path bonus Precision with Domination: +5 → +6 AD or +9 → +10 AP
Tooltip wording: Bone Plating

V8.6.summary: New keystone: Conqueror; Chrysalis replaces Iron Skin and Mirror Shell
items: New keystone: Conqueror (Precision, 4th keystone)
New rune: Chrysalis (Resolve, second row); Iron Skin and Mirror Shell removed
Bone Plating: duration 5s → 3s
Tooltip fix: Aftershock's summary says magic damage (was adaptive); the shockwave has dealt magic damage since launch

V8.7.summary: Presence of Mind and Manaflow Band reworked; Resolve path Health scales
items: Presence of Mind reworked: takedowns restore 20% max mana and refund 10% of your ultimate's cooldown (was: free mana for 7s after a level-up or takedown)
Manaflow Band reworked: ability hits on champions grant +25 max mana (up to 250), then 1% missing mana every 5s; cooldown 15s
Cut Down: up to 10% → 12% more damage
Zombie Ward: duration 60–180s → 30–120s
Tooltip wording: Absolute Focus now states its level-1 bonus, 3 AD or 5 AP (unchanged)
Approach Velocity: 10% → 15% Movement Speed; Legend: Tenacity: 1.5% → 2.5% per stack
Path bonus Health with Resolve now scales with level: +65 → +15–135, +130 → +30–270, +145 → +35–300
Lethal Tempo: Attack Speed 30–80% → 40–110%

V8.9.summary: Unsealed Spellbook reworked into Summoner Spell swaps
items: Unsealed Spellbook reworked: swap a Summoner Spell for a single-use one (first swap at 6 min, 4 min cooldown); was: Summoner Shards and 15% shorter cooldowns
Inspiration keystones reordered: Glacial Augment, Kleptomancy, Unsealed Spellbook

V8.10.summary: Cheap Shot, Ingenious Hunter, Phase Rush, Demolish up; Bone Plating down
items: Cheap Shot: 12–30 → 15–40 true damage
Ingenious Hunter: 10% + 6% per stack → 15% + 5% per stack Active Item CDR
Phase Rush: Movement Speed 15–40% → 25–40%
Perfect Timing: Stopwatch after 10 → 8 min
Demolish: 125 → 175 (+30% max health) damage
Chrysalis: 60 → 50 starting health
Bone Plating: 20–50 → 15–40 less damage

V8.11.summary: New keystone Hail of Blades; new runes Ultimate Hunter and Nimbus Cloak
items: New keystone: Hail of Blades (Domination, 4th keystone)
New rune: Ultimate Hunter (Domination, third row, 4th rune)
New rune: Nimbus Cloak (Sorcery, first row), replacing The Ultimate Hat
Fleet Footwork: AP ratio 0.4 → 0.5, Movement Speed 30% → 20%; healing from minions 60% → 100% effective (melee) and 30% → 20% (ranged); critical-hit healing bonus removed
Minion Dematerializer: on cooldown for the first 155s → 240s

V8.12.summary: Celerity conversion doubled; Hail of Blades Attack Speed up
items: Celerity: Movement Speed 3% → 1.5%; conversion 4.8% → 9.6% AD or 8% → 16% AP
Hail of Blades: Attack Speed 50–100% → 75–125%

V8.13.summary: Hail of Blades and Unsealed Spellbook buffs; Domination path bonus up
items: Hail of Blades: up to 1.5s → 2s between attacks; cooldown 5s → 4s
Unsealed Spellbook: each unique spell cuts the swap cooldown by 15s → 20s
Path bonus Domination: +11 → +12 AD or +18 → +20 AP (with Sorcery or Inspiration); with Precision +13 → +14 AP; with Resolve +5 → +6 AD or +9 → +10 AP

V8.14.summary: Ghost Poro and Zombie Ward reworked; Conqueror minimum AD 10 → 6
items: Ghost Poro reworked: entering brush swaps your trinket for a Ghost Poro (vision 300s); 5–20 adaptive force while you or the poro is in enemy territory
Zombie Ward reworked: ward takedowns raise Zombie Wards (120s), and your next hit on a champion deals 30–90 bonus magic damage
Conqueror: 10–35 → 6–35 AD
Perfect Timing: Stopwatch after 8 → 10 min

V8.16.summary: Electrocute, Cheap Shot, Sudden Impact, Celerity, Scorch nerfs
items: Electrocute: damage 50–220 → 30–180, ratios 0.5 → 0.4 bonus AD and 0.3 → 0.25 AP; cooldown 50–25s → 25–20s
Cheap Shot: 15–40 → 8–40 true damage
Sudden Impact: 10 → 7 Lethality, 8 → 6 Magic Penetration
Summon Aery: damage 15–40 → 10–40; shield 30–80 → 35–80
Celerity: conversion 9.6% → 6% AD or 16% → 10% AP
Scorch: damage 20–60 → 10–30; cooldown 20s → 10s

V8.20.summary: Dark Harvest base damage 40–80 → 20–60; Biscuit Delivery tooltip fix
items: Dark Harvest: base damage 40–80 → 20–60
Tooltip fix: Biscuit Delivery says selling a biscuit also raises the mana cap, as it always did
Tooltip wording: Scorch says damaging abilities

V8.22.summary: Time Warp Tonic reworked; last patch of Season 8
items: Time Warp Tonic reworked: potions and biscuits restore 50% at once, then go on a short cooldown (was: 20% longer duration)

V8.23.summary: Preseason 9: stat shards replace path bonuses; Dark Harvest, Celerity reworked
items: Stat shards added: Offense +10 Adaptive Force / +9% Attack Speed / +1–10% CDR; Flex +10 Adaptive Force / +5 Armor / +6 Magic Resist; Defense +15–90 Health / +5 Armor / +6 Magic Resist
Path-pair bonuses removed
Dark Harvest reworked: damaging a champion below 50% health deals 50–80 damage (+8 per soul harvested), cooldown 45s
Celerity reworked: all movement bonuses are 8% more effective
Kleptomancy: the next 2 attacks on champions after an ability can grant gold or items
New rune: Shield Bash (Resolve, first row); Chrysalis removed, Bone Plating moves to the second row (25–50 less damage, lasts 1.5s)
Overgrowth: +0.2% max health per 8 deaths → +3 health per 8, and +2.5% max health at 120
Demolish: 175 → 100 damage, charge 4s → 3s; Fleet Footwork AP ratio 0.5 → 0.3; Ravenous Hunter 2.5% → 1.5% base healing
Hotfix during the patch (November 20): Dark Harvest 50–80 → 40–80 damage, +8 → +5 per soul; this page keeps the patch-day values

V8.24.summary: Dark Harvest base damage 40–80 → 20–60; Shield Bash tooltip fix
items: Dark Harvest: base damage 40–80 → 20–60 (the tooltip also takes the V8.23 hotfix: 50–80 → 40–80, +8 → +5 per soul)
Tooltip fix: Shield Bash damage 4–22 → 4–21, its value since launch in V8.23

V9.1.summary: Hail of Blades reworked; Attack Speed shard 9% → 10%
items: Hail of Blades: 75–125% → 110% Attack Speed; attack resets add one attack
Celerity: movement bonuses 8% → 10% more effective
Shield Bash: damage 4–21 → 5–30
Stat shard: Attack Speed +9% → +10%

V9.2.summary: Cut Down reworked; Absolute Focus, Overheal, Legend: Bloodline; shard values
items: Cut Down: now 4–10% more damage, scaling with how much more max health (10–100%) the enemy has
Absolute Focus: up to 24 → 18 AD or 40 → 30 AP (level 1: 3 → 1.8 AD, 5 → 3 AP)
Overheal: shield now built from 40–100% of excess healing from you or allies (was 40% of self-healing, 300% of ally healing)
Legend: Bloodline: 0.8% → 0.6% life steal per stack, max stacks 10 → 20
Stat shards: Adaptive Force +10 → +9; Armor +5 → +6; Magic Resist +6 → +8

V9.4.summary: Conqueror reworked into stacking Adaptive Force
items: Conqueror reworked: damaging a champion grants 3–15 Adaptive Force for 3s (8s melee), up to 5 stacks; at 5 stacks 10% of damage becomes true damage and heals you (was: after 4s in combat, 6–35 AD and 20% true damage)
Hotfix during the patch (February 22): 2–10 Adaptive Force per stack, ranged stacks 3s → 2s (melee keeps 8s); this page keeps the patch-day values

V9.5.summary: Conqueror nerfed to 2–6 Adaptive Force per stack; Cut Down 4–10% → 5–12%
items: Conqueror: 3–15 → 2–6 Adaptive Force per stack, ranged stacks 3s → 2s (Riot's notes: 2–10 → 2–6; the rest is the V9.4 hotfix)

V9.6.summary: Minion Dematerializer and Overheal changes; Conqueror tooltip wording
items: Minion Dematerializer: 6 → 3 dematerializers, available after 240s → 180s; damage bonus +4% → +6% (+1% → +3% per extra minion)
Overheal: shield built from 40–100% → 20–100% of excess healing
Tooltip wording: Conqueror's summary line rewritten

V9.7.summary: Ghost Poro, Zombie Ward and Eyeball Collection grant stacking AD/AP
items: Ghost Poro reworked: expiring wards leave a Ghost Poro (vision 60s); +1.2 AD or +2 AP per poro, up to 10, then +10 adaptive force
Zombie Ward: now +1.2 AD or +2 AP per Zombie Ward, up to 10, then +10 adaptive force (the bonus magic damage is gone)
Eyeball Collection: 1 eyeball per champion takedown, wards no longer count; +0.6 → +1.2 AD or +1 → +2 AP each, complete at 20 → 10
Ultimate Hunter: +2% → +3% per Bounty Hunter stack
Demolish: 30% → 35% of max health
Overgrowth: bonus at 120 absorbed 2.5% → 3.5% max health

V9.8.summary: Coup de Grace: 7% → 8% damage, takedown bonus removed
items: Coup de Grace: 7% → 8% more damage; the adaptive bonus after champion takedowns (9 AD or 15 AP for 10s) is removed

V9.9.summary: Aftershock resists rework; Celerity, Magical Footwear and 7 more
items: Aftershock: resists 70–120 → 70 + 50% of bonus resists (capped at 80–150); damage +3% → +4% max health, AD and AP ratios removed
Celerity: movement bonuses 10% → 7% more effective, plus 1% Movement Speed
Magical Footwear: boots at 10 → 12 min, 30s → 45s sooner per takedown
Relentless Hunter: 8 + 8 per stack → 10 + 9 per stack; Ultimate Hunter: +3% → +4% per stack
Cheap Shot: 8–40 → 10–45 true damage; Scorch: 10–30 → 15–35 damage
Conditioning: +8 → +9 Armor and Magic Resist; Bone Plating: 25–50 → 30–60 less damage
Ghost Poro: spotting an enemy champion now also grants a stack
Conqueror: at full stacks 10% → 8% of damage converted to true damage

V9.11.summary: Tooltip fix: Guardian's shield AP ratio prints 25% (was 0.25%)
items: Tooltip fix: Guardian's shield AP ratio prints 25% (was 0.25%; the ratio has been 25% since V8.2)

V9.16.summary: Biscuit Delivery: biscuits every 2 min until 6 min
items: Biscuit Delivery: a biscuit every 3 → 2 min, until 12 → 6 min
Biscuit Delivery: restore 15% → 10% missing health and mana (manaless 20% → 12%); mana cap +40 → +50

V9.22.summary: No rune changes since V9.16; last patch of Season 9
items: No rune changes since V9.16 — last patch of Season 9

V9.23.summary: Preseason 10: Prototype: Omnistone replaces Kleptomancy; Conqueror reworked
items: New keystone: Prototype: Omnistone (Inspiration), replacing Kleptomancy

Conqueror reworked: 2 stacks per hit (ranged basic attacks 1), 2–5 Adaptive Force per stack, up to 10; stacks last 8s for everyone (ranged was 2s); full stacks heal for 15% of damage to champions (true damage removed)
Aftershock: resists 70 + 50% → 35 + 80% of bonus resists; damage 10–120 (+4% max health) → 25–120 (+8% bonus health); cooldown 35s → 20s
Presence of Mind: takedowns now raise max mana by 100 (up to 500) or max energy by 10 (up to 50) instead of refunding ultimate cooldown
Nimbus Cloak reworked: triggers after a Summoner Spell (was: the ultimate), 15–35% Movement Speed based on the spell's cooldown
Eyeball Collection: 1 eyeball per takedown → 2 per kill and 1 per assist (the tooltip says 2 per takedown); +1.2 → +0.6 AD or +2 → +1 AP each, complete at 10 → 20
Hotfix during the patch (November 21): Prototype: Omnistone 8–4s → 7–3s between keystones (ranged 12–8s → 11–7s); this page keeps the patch-day values
Conqueror: stacks last 8s → 6s; ranged champions heal for 8% (melee 15%)

V10.1.summary: Eyeball Collection back to 10 eyeballs; Prototype: Omnistone faster
items: Eyeball Collection: back to 1 eyeball per takedown (was 2 per kill and 1 per assist); +0.6 → +1.2 AD or +1 → +2 AP each, complete at 20 → 10
Prototype: Omnistone: time between keystones 7–3s → 5–3s (ranged 11–7s → 9–7s); until now the tooltip showed the pre-hotfix 8–4s (12–8s)

V10.4.summary: Perfect Timing reworked; Phase Rush and Hail of Blades changes
items: Perfect Timing: Stopwatch after 10 → 14 min, 2 min sooner per takedown; the cooldown reduction on Zhonya's Hourglass, Guardian Angel and Gargoyle Stoneplate is removed
Phase Rush: 3 hits within 3s → 4s; melee champions now get 30–50% Movement Speed
Hail of Blades: up to 2s → 3s between attacks; cooldown 4s out of combat → a flat 8s (the tooltip says 8s out of combat with champions until V11.2)

V10.5.summary: Tooltip wording: Perfect Timing renames its Stopwatch
items: Tooltip wording: Perfect Timing calls its item a Perfectly Timed Stopwatch (Stopwatch again from V10.7) and drops the line about replacing the Stopwatch in the item shop; Riot's notes list only a bug fix

V10.6.summary: Tooltip wording: Summon Aery rewritten, numbers unchanged
items: Tooltip wording: Summon Aery (attacks or abilities on champions send Aery to damage; empowering or protecting allies sends her to shield); numbers unchanged

V10.7.summary: Phase Rush melee 30–50% → 40–60%; Conditioning after 10 → 12 min
items: Phase Rush: melee Movement Speed 30–50% → 40–60%
Conditioning: bonus starts after 10 → 12 min
Tooltip wording: Perfect Timing's item is a Stopwatch again (was Perfectly Timed Stopwatch)

V10.12.summary: Predator, Unflinching, Approach Velocity and Guardian reworked

Unflinching reworked: 10% Tenacity and Slow Resist, up to 20% more based on missing health (was: after casting a Summoner Spell)
Approach Velocity: 15% → 7.5% Movement Speed toward impaired enemies, 15% toward enemies you impair; impaired allies no longer count
Guardian: range 175 → 350; triggers only after 90–250 damage taken within 2.5s, or on lethal damage (was any damage); shield 70–150 → 80–200; haste removed
Tooltip only: Glacial Augment says Energized attacks also fire the freeze ray (a tooltip error, gone in V10.13)

V10.13.summary: Conqueror up to 12 stacks of 1.7–4.2; Guardian shield back to 70–150
items: Conqueror: 2–5 → 1.7–4.2 Adaptive Force per stack, max stacks 10 → 12
Guardian: shield 80–200 → 70–150
Tooltip fix: Glacial Augment no longer mentions Energized attacks
Predator: damage 30–90 → 40–120; cooldown 100–70s → 90–60s

V10.15.summary: Unsealed Spellbook: 25s per unique spell, first cooldown 5 min
items: Unsealed Spellbook: each unique spell cuts the swap cooldown by 20s → 25s; initial swap cooldown 4 → 5 min
Nimbus Cloak: Movement Speed 15–35% → 10–30%

V10.18.summary: Guardian: shield ratios 25% → 15% AP, 12% → 9% bonus health
items: Guardian: shield ratios 25% → 15% AP and 12% → 9% bonus health

V10.20.summary: Relentless Hunter: 10 + 9 per stack → 5 + 8 per stack
items: Relentless Hunter: out of combat Movement Speed 10 + 9 per stack → 5 + 8 per stack
Nimbus Cloak: duration 2.5s → 2s; Movement Speed 10–30% → 5–35%

V10.22.summary: No rune changes since V10.21; last patch of Season 10
items: No rune changes since V10.21 — last patch of Season 10

Presence of Mind reworked: damaging a champion grants 1.5–11 mana per second for 4s (energy: 1.5); takedowns restore 15% mana or energy (was 20%, plus max mana)
Transcendence reworked: +5 Ability Haste at levels 5 and 8; from level 11, takedowns cut basic ability cooldowns by 20%
Cosmic Insight: CDR → +15 Summoner Spell Haste and +10 Item Haste

items: Ultimate Hunter: 5% + 4% per stack ultimate CDR → 6 + 5 per stack Ability Haste
Cosmic Insight: +15 → +18 Summoner Spell Haste

items: Ravenous Hunter: +2% → +1.7% Omnivamp per stack
Tooltip fix: Hail of Blades' cooldown reads a flat 8s; it stopped depending on combat in V10.4

V11.6.summary: Fleet Footwork AP ratio 0.3 → 0.2; Ravenous Hunter base Omnivamp removed

V11.19.summary: Tooltip fix: Predator shows its V11.18 buff, 60% Movement Speed over 1s
items: Tooltip fix: Predator ramps up to 60% Movement Speed over 1s (was shown as 45% over 1.5s); the change itself came in V11.18

V11.21.summary: Conqueror stacks shorter; Ingenious Hunter up; Health shard 15–90 → 15–140

V11.23.summary: Preseason 12: First Strike replaces Omnistone; Lethal Tempo, Glacial Augment reworked
items: New keystone: First Strike (Inspiration), replacing Prototype: Omnistone

Lethal Tempo reworked: each attack on a champion grants 15% (melee) or 5% (ranged) Attack Speed for 6s, up to 90% / 30%; at full stacks Attack Speed can pass 2.5 and attack range grows by 50 / 100 (was: 40–110% for 3s, 1.5s after damaging a champion)
Glacial Augment reworked: immobilizing a champion fires 3 glacial rays that leave frozen zones (35% slow, enemies deal 15% less damage to your allies); cooldown 25s
